strings.#30:
SPHERES (tm) makes 3D-looking colorful orbs that fill your screen.

"Max Size" is the maiximum size of a sphere.

"Offset" controls the shape of the sphere.  The larger the offset, the more egg-shaped the sphere will be.

"Clear Every" sets the number of spheres drawn before clearing the screen.

Based on Spheres by Bruce Burkhalter.
